items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: I never did play with him and play with him at all.

ctx.x: The man who has the church now? He was sitting on the call in your face.

Yeah, old Jim was a musician. He played a tenor, upright tenor. Who did he play with? Day Range Band. Why, why, why, why. Jim come from, from Jim home. I broke Jim in. Jordan Lewis. Sam Morgan. All them fellas. PT? Who? What is PT? No, no. I never did play with him and play with him at all.
Did you know Joe Petit? Joe Petit.
